card.name: Abuse, toxicity and transport words
card.fires_on: The words abuse, abused, toxicity and transport (transporting, transported) in drug-label text. Often follows a noun like opioid, alcohol, bromide or nucleoside.

modes.label: Abuse and misuse
modes.description: The word abuse or abused after a substance such as opioid or alcohol.
modes.example: Screen patients for risk of substance use disorders, including opioid<< abuse>> and misuse, and warn them of the

modes.label: Toxicity
modes.description: The word toxicity, or its ending, after a drug name in overdose or warning sections.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE Bromide<< toxicity>> Indications of toxicity due to oral

modes.label: Transport
modes.description: Forms of transport describing drug transporter proteins or inhibitors.
modes.example: ACTIONS Methylxanthines interfere with the activity of adenosine injection ( 7.1 , 10 ) Nucleoside<< transport>> inhibitors such as dipyridamole
